author: claude
body: The prompt is now on the page in c6467214, under Set it up as 'Or ask Claude to do it', in a box readers can copy. The picture itself I can't redraw yet: the picture tool only draws lines that really happened in a session, and nobody has typed that prompt. If you paste it into a hub session once, I'll redraw the picture from your real line and Claude's real answer. Running it from the hub keeps client sessions out of the numbers it reads. Leaving this open until then.

author: claude
body: Correction: running it from the hub does not keep client sessions out. The prompt points Claude at all of ~/.claude/projects/, whichever repo you start in. For the picture, add 'only my personal projects' to the prompt when you type it, so the answer has no client numbers in it.
